first_stage.device_request: Explicit job_pb2.DeviceConfig(cpu=job_pb2.CpuDevice(variant="cpu")); do not rely on ResourceSpec(device=None) as proof of CPU-only placement.
first_stage.backend: JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu set before imports; source imports and distributed initialization remain unexecuted. CPU backend selection is independent of scheduler placement.

entrypoint_order: Parse immutable explicit manifest; verify candidate module hashes from disk before runtime imports; reject unsupported scenarios, absent health budget, missing attempt identity or non-CPU requested configuration.

Read only allowlisted task identity fields; never serialize JobInfo credentials/env wholesale. Bind exact task wire ID, attempt UID, worker ID, campaign, scenario and per-process fresh random native run ID.

Initialize native W&B with mode=online and resume=never before JAX import/backend use; reject returned offline/disabled run. Persist run URL/config identity locally without secrets. This is local initialization evidence; independently audit native state/history later.

Import actual candidate WandbTracker/BackgroundTracker and distributed installer; initialize Iris JAX world with named endpoint scoped to task attempt. Do not create arrays, query memory, compile or step optimizers.

Create BackgroundTracker(WandbTracker(run=the_existing_online_run, suppress_logging=False)) on every rank for diagnostic sentinel delivery. This differs from training rank-zero-only publishing; installer still requires W&B only on rank zero, so all-rank native delivery remains independently audited.

Log a fixed small sequence of plain Python scalar sentinel IDs on each rank. Explicitly stop producers before finish. For application_failure inject SystemExit(23) on one declared rank after sentinel enqueue; preserve that error through finalization.
Call finish_with_report once per tracker and preserve application exception precedence if cleanup fails. Persist report and error type; no forced native finished state.

Install actual coordinated finalizer with local identity-bound observation after the last JAX use; propagate original application exception. Local output flush failures remain visible, no worker holder or watchdog.
Let Python atexit and scheduler/controller task aggregation run naturally; collect only newly authorized diagnostic evidence once. No terminal training evidence is reread.
cpu_scope_limits: CPU placement and no-accelerator request must be verified from new task resource records when a job is authorized; JAX_PLATFORMS alone cannot prove placement.

No existing GPU allocation is canceled, resized or released. CPU-only stage avoids designing an accelerator holder for these new CPU diagnostics; it does not solve retention for any future accelerator qualification.
Four tasks do not guarantee four distinct physical workers. Record placements; do not claim cross-host qualification unless distinct hosts are observed.
No TPU/GPU backend teardown, model sharding, device memory pressure or checkpoint resume conclusion.
Native W&B lifecycle behavior is real only in future authorized execution; current source review supplies no online authentication or transport evidence.
health_budget_constraints: Keep Iris scheduler default preemption/retry policies and no job/task/wrapper wallclock limits.

BackgroundTracker has an existing 120-second finish wait; JAX source defaults include 1800-second init,100-second heartbeat,120-second shutdown. These are source defaults, not measured upper bounds or a validated repaired budget.
A finalization rendezvous budget remains explicit and unset pending a justified scenario-specific choice. Do not infer historical cause or solve missing peers by increasing timeouts alone.

remaining: Implement the non-training entrypoint without importing/running runtime services in local checks.
Test startup ordering and application-versus-cleanup failure precedence with fake external boundaries; do not repeat published candidate tests.
Bind installed source/runtime/controller identity and fresh-attempt endpoint evidence before proposing execution.
Publish runnable scope and exact health-budget justification before requesting new-job authorization.

proposed_health_budget.reason: Clean/application-failure first stage has four scalar sentinels and no deliberate delay. Existing BackgroundTracker finish wait is120s;300s allows180s additional rank scheduling/local diagnostic skew before declaring rendezvous unhealthy. This margin is a design choice, not a measured bound or demonstrated cure. Each ready/read barrier uses the budget; no total job or wrapper deadline is imposed.
limits: Background finish wait does not bound arbitrary pre-finish blocking, Python scheduling or filesystem writes.
No guarantee of eventual cleanup under a missing peer or failed filesystem.
Future delayed-rank or missing-peer scenarios need separate justification and explicit scope.
